experiments.scope: The exact sha256-r38-prefix-v1 target. Per organizer seed: one group of the attack driver of proof.md Section 4.6 (experiments/d1core.py, byte-identical to Appendix A) on the r38fam first-block family: 8 random words of W0..W14 from SHAKE-256(seed), the 7 family words solved (W16 + s0(W8) + W7, the constant parts of W17, W19, W21, W22, W24 equal 0 and W20 = -K20, checked on the scalar schedule of every lane checked), rL and rb from the seed, and 4 batches (variants rb..rb+3 mod 32) of 256 lanes, W15 = ((L ^ rL) << 9) | (v << 27). Each request first runs calibrate on variants 0 and 31 (the counted 64-register programs against a gate-by-gate evaluation on three groups). Checked against the scalar 38-step compression: 8 seed-chosen lanes per batch, every lane the circuit marks as passing W7 and every lane it flags (W7 and stage 3a): the circuit's W7 and flag decisions; the flagged lanes are exactly the lanes the driver sends to Step 3, with their full chaining values; for every flagged lane and the first W7 lane of each batch the second-block pair (published W14, W15) follows every A/E cell of rows -4..15 and every W cell except the XOR cell of W7; Step 3 runs on every flagged lane. Returns the 128-byte pair M0||M1, M0||M1' of the first flagged lane if every check passed, else two nulls.
experiments.hypothesis: Full collisions: 0 (per-trial probability below 2^-60). Expectation as a range, frozen with the program (PREREG_fb.txt) before any run of the frozen program on the public seed: under the independent-uniform model a trial returns a pair with probability 1 - (1 - p2 2^-10)^1024 = 0.06471 (p2 = 2^-3.90197), about 16.6 of 256, witness range 6..30. The count is a witness observation only: no independence of the organizer's trials is assumed and no statistical inference is drawn from it; H1's rates rest on the grp38fam.c measurement (claim.json H1). Observations per trial (participant numbers): mismatches 0, variant_ops (the counted operations of variants 0 and 31, summed: 87,359); lanes_checked, w7_pass, hits, stage3b and cells_checked are reported. Local emulations with the frozen and with the amended program (same counts): our own seed set returned 12 pairs, the public-seed request (no holdout nonce) 17 pairs, 0 mismatches. The experiment exhibits the flag path on organizer seeds and checks the circuit's W7 and flag decisions lane by lane; it does not estimate rates and does not test q3. Every returned pair can be checked offline: its common first block M0 gives a CV1 that passes W7 and the ten E16 cells, and M1 is the Step-2 image of that CV1.

experiments.scope: H2 (proof.md Sections 6.4 and 10.2). experiments/d1core.py (the same file; its q3 code is byte-identical to that of submission 3d819a4b) runs q3_experiment: an exact enumeration of row 16 (2^19 words) and, in trials 0..19, one reduced replicate each of the sequential Monte-Carlo estimator of q3 (NP 64; 128, 4, 4, 1, 1, 1 children per particle at rows 17..22; 512 tail proposals per particle; randomness from SHAKE-256 of the trial seed), which samples the second-block words from their exact distribution under H1 (Lemma 2). Every tail success is rebuilt (W0..W7 by the inverse expansion, CV1 by inverting steps 7..0 from S) and accepted only if the reference 38-step compression gives F(CV1, M1) = F(CV1, M1') with M1 != M1', W7 passes Step 2 and every cell holds. Trial t < 20 returns its first accepted pair as the 96-byte strings CV1||M1 and CV1||M1' iff it has a success and all were accepted; trial 20 returns a pair iff all 20 did and the mean of the 20 estimates is >= 2^-101.40; trials 21..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Returned pairs: expected 21 (trials 0..20; 21 in 51 of 51 validation requests), stated as the range 0..21: each replicate without an accepted success removes its own pair and that of trial 20, and a failed pooled rule removes trial 20's. The count is a witness observation, not a test. Full collisions: 0 (the strings are semi-free-start collisions from CV1, not collisions from the IV; they can be checked offline). Under H2 each replicate is an unbiased estimate of q3 = 2^-101 with relative sd about 0.32. The pass rule (mean of the 20 estimates >= 2^-101.40) is a sanity threshold fixed before any validation run; it is not used to derive the claimed bound, which rests on the preregistered sample (claim.json H2), and no independence of the organizer's trials is assumed. The design and rule were frozen (PREREG_q3x.txt) before any validation run; on 51 requests of our own every request returned 21 pairs (1,020 replicates, mean 2^-101.0186, 69,190 successes all accepted); a local emulation of the public-seed request returned 21 pairs. Observations (participant numbers): per replicate log2_estimate, row16_words 32, survivors per stage, tail_successes, verified_pairs, failed_rebuilds 0; trial 20 log2_pooled_mean.
